_comment: Advisories accepted after review (AUDIT_REPORT.md F-26). scripts/audit-check.mjs fails on anything else and on entries that stop matching. Re-review when upgrading react-router-dom to 7.x or zod to 4.x, which clears all three.

advisories.reason: Open redirect via a backslash in <Link>/useNavigate targets. The app only navigates to fixed in-app paths; no target comes from user input or the URL.
Constructor injection in deserializeErrors() used when hydrating server-rendered data-router errors. The app is a client-only SPA (BrowserRouter, no SSR, no data router), so the function never runs.
Memory exhaustion validating oversized constrained collections. zod only parses responses from our own API, whose sizes the server bounds; no user-supplied payload is validated with zod.
